name: Service To Others
overview: Scripture reveals that true greatness in the Kingdom of God is marked by humble service to others, following the example of Christ who came not to be served but to serve and give His life for many. Believers are called to serve selflessly and generously, as those who freely give will themselves be blessed and refreshed. Service must be done with sincerity and not for public recognition, emphasizing a heart aligned with God's reward rather than human approval. Ultimately, serving others is an expression of loving care for those in need, including the hungry, thirsty, and strangers, reflecting Christ’s own ministry.
